<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.43.0 -->

## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* `st.chat_input` with file uploader by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9491
* Add `theme.roundness` theming option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10246
* Add `theme.borderColor` and `theme.showBorderAroundInputs` config options by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10259
* Add `theme.linkColor` theming config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10271
* Add theming options to configure custom fonts by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10345
* Add `theme.baseFontSize` theming config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10375
* Allow configuring the row height for `st.dataframe` and `st.data_editor` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9549
* Always scroll to bottom when adding new rows in data editor by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10405
* Add .xml to the list of allowed static file extensions by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10337
* Add pre-defined formats to `st.column_config` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10179
* Allow static serving for common font files by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10335
* add transparent file upload drop target to chat input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10395
* Update Bokeh error message to redirect to streamlit-bokeh custom component by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10374
* Extend st.navigation functionality to support various page input types by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10358
* Add json column for `st.dataframe` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10172
* Add autosize option to dataframe column menu by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10476
* Download button: Allow to not trigger rerun by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10296
* Change dataframe column format from UI by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10420
* Allow small text in Markdown by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10487
* Allow hiding dataframe columns from UI by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10264
* Set `use_container_width=True` by default for `st.dataframe` and `st.data_editor` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10434
* Support polars dataframe/series hashing by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10408
* Add timezone and timezone_offset to the st.context by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10336
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Use compact file uploader based on element width by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10272
* Fix issue with active pills & segmented control label font-size by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10349
* Fix the usage of dataframe column menu in dialog by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10359
* Apply default rounding to graphviz charts by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10224
* [fix] chat input multi-line shrinks after drag and drop by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10364
* Fix: `st.logo` unmounts with use of `st.fragment` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10377
* Prevent showing tooltips on trailing dataframe row by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10398
* Revamp disabled state for chat input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10441
* [Fix] Reuse event loop logic by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10455
* [Fix]: `st.altair_chart` selection interval showing `true` tooltip by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10456
* Time formatting logic update: seconds/minutes/hours display by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10410
* Fix regression with column order not getting updated by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10445
* [fix] Tabs content flickering by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10533
### Other Changes
* Hide the top colored line for custom themes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10323
* Remove `rich` from required dependencies by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10320
* Release/1.42.0 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10338
* Raise an exception when provider name contains underscore by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10360
* Fix typo in set_page_config doc string by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10372
* Release/1.42.1 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10421
* Release/1.42.2 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10472
* Fix deprecation with `fillna` pandas method by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10484

## New Contributors
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10354
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10372
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10358
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10463
